description:
• Brand introduction: FUELL started with the unexpected encounter and Franco-American convergence between Erik Buell, Frédéric Vasseur, and François-Xavier Terny. The unifying idea: to create an urban mobility solution for cities, which is currently the best application of electric powertrains. The founders combined their experience and competences to invent a genuinely new experience entirely focused in the urban rider's needs.


• Product description: Fllow electric motorcycle is the new brainchild of legendary Erik Buell and his team. This e-motorcycle is the ultimate combination of practicality, performance, and urban design, making it an excellent choice for those who prioritize all three. It’s a solution for congested cities, and a true car replacement in many instances. 
This electric motorcycle boasts a 10kWh battery and a high-performance wheel motor with a maximum power of 35kW (a 11kW version is also available to meet car license requirements in the EU). With a top speed of 85mph/140kmh, it can travel a distance up to 150 miles or 240 km on a single charge in an urban cycle.
Priced at $12,995 and with powerful acceleration, large urban range, fast charging capabilities, innovative wheel motor, sleek design, and advanced safety features, it becomes an ideal choice for both urban riding and commuting.


• USP (Unique Selling Point):

  1. Fast Charging: With a charging time of less than 30 minutes on public chargers (up to 50kW), the Fllow can be quickly recharged  for continued use.
  2. Long Range: Fllow comes with a high-capacity 10 kWh battery that offers a real urban range up to150 miles (240 km)
  3. High acceleration: Fllow's electric powertrain provides instant torque (750 Nm), making it capable of high acceleration.
  4. Large storage capacity: The Fllow electric motorcycle has a 50-liter storage capacity, allowing riders to carry/store a full-face helmet and other items.
  5. Vehicle Status Application on iPhone/Android: This app offers all practical information and functionalities for the rider, including ignition, location, charge level, alarm (if incident), the opening of storage and saddle, access to charging port, navigation, service manual and maintenance alerts, and contact with FUELL.
  6. eTraction Control: This helps improve traction and stability on the road, making the ride smoother and more secure.
  7. 2 Ride Modes (Urban, Audacious): Riders can choose between two modes to match their riding style and conditions - “urban” to conserve energy and best adapted to congested cities, or “audacious” where top speed and top acceleration is available.
  8. Illuminated Storage Compartment: This allows riders to easily access their belongings in low light conditions.
    Integrated regenerative ABS: This improves braking performance and helps prevent accidents, while recharging the battery when slowing down or braking.
  9. Hands-Free Lock/Unlock and Engage: This convenient feature allows the rider to lock or unlock the bike without using a key.
  10. Connected, Interactive Dashboard: This displays important information and allows riders to interact with the bike's various functions.
  11. Walk and Reverse Assist: This makes it easier to maneuver the bike in tight spaces or when backing up.
  12. Blind Spot Detection: This alerts riders to potential hazards in their blind spots, helping to prevent accidents.
  13. Front and Rear Collision Warning: This alerts riders to potential collisions in front of them, helping to prevent accidents.
  14. 21 utility and design patents
